name: ROPgadget - ROP/JOP Gadget Finder
description: ROPgadget scans a binary for Return/Jump-Oriented-Programming gadgets - short instruction sequences ending in ret/jmp/call - used to build ROP chains that bypass non-executable stack (NX/DEP). It can also auto-generate a ropchain for simple cases and filter gadgets by pattern.
notes:
=== BASIC ===
  ROPgadget --binary <binary>
  ROPgadget --binary <binary> | wc -l     # count gadgets

=== FILTER ===
  ROPgadget --binary <binary> --only 'pop|ret'
  ROPgadget --binary <binary> --re 'pop rdi'      # find 'pop rdi; ret'
  ROPgadget --binary <binary> --string '/bin/sh'  # find string address
  ROPgadget --binary <binary> --memstr '/bin/sh'  # build string from bytes

=== AUTO CHAIN ===
  ROPgadget --binary <binary> --ropchain    # attempt to auto-build execve chain

=== TYPICAL x86-64 PRIMITIVES ===
  pop rdi; ret     # 1st arg
  pop rsi; ret / pop rsi; pop r15; ret
  pop rdx; ret
  syscall; ret

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  ropper              # similar, supports more filters/formats
  pwntools ROP()      # programmatic chain building
  radare2 /R          # in-RE gadget search

references.title: MITRE T1203 - Exploitation for Client Execution

recommended.note: Feed gadgets into pwntools ROP chains.
one_gadget as a simpler single-shot alternative.
radare2 can also search gadgets inline.

defense.why_it_works: When the stack is non-executable (NX/DEP), attackers reuse existing executable code. ROPgadget enumerates reusable instruction sequences so a chain can call functions/syscalls without injecting shellcode.
defense.prerequisites: A control-flow-hijack primitive (e.g. stack overflow) plus a binary/libc to source gadgets from.
defense.impact: NX/DEP bypass enabling arbitrary code execution via return-oriented programming.
defense.detection: Not detectable as a tool (offline gadget search). On the target, ROP execution may trip EDR control-flow/stack-pivot heuristics at exploit time.
defense.artifacts: None from the tool itself; exploitation shows as EDR CFG/stack-pivot alerts or crashes on the target.
defense.prevention: Enable PIE+full ASLR (randomizes gadget addresses), RELRO, and especially hardware CFI (Intel CET shadow stack / ARM PAC) and compiler CFG to break ROP chains; keep binaries small/stripped of useful gadgets; patch the underlying memory bug.
